decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis offset initiates at index 482 (N↑, E↓, U↓) with sustained deviation through index 530. N remains elevated, E shows only partial recovery, and U recovers gradually but not fully by end of allowed context (570). No clear opposing return observed in any axis before 570; thus the interval is uncertain. No other temporary offsets detected within allowed_context [445,570].
